failure_patterns.pattern: rule_ignored: Answers were too broad or too narrow despite existing instructions to return the requested modifier, full restored phrase, or shared name component.

rejected_edits.content: When the clue already supplies a category or type, omit a merely descriptive category label, but retain words that are integral to the entity's conventional proper name (such as lexicalized place-name prefixes). Return the canonical name, not just a bare distinguishing element.
rejected_edits.target: When the clue already supplies the category or type, return the distinguishing value alone: do not append a generic category noun, institution label, explanatory wording, or unnecessary title, subtitle, or suffix unless needed for disambiguation.

rejected_edits.content: - When a prompt is only a list of names, use the context to identify a salient shared relation or affiliation and return that relation—not another listed name. Infer it only when the context supports a clear answer; otherwise do not guess.
rejected_edits.target: - Treat terse statements, quoted fragments, and incomplete phrases as information-seeking clues when appropriate. Infer the answer slot from the wording, then use the context to identify the entity or value that satisfies the clue.
